commit_message:
feat(tiling): add makeInnerTileAlignmentFn and thread it through tile-and-fuse

Add makeInnerTileAlignmentFn (TileAndFuseUtils), which builds an
InnerTileAlignment control function marking each scalable (dynamic) inner tile
of a tiled/fused linalg.pack/unpack with a given alignment. Thread the control
function through the tile+fuse helpers: fuseProducersOfSlices reads it from
SCFTilingOptions and fuseConsumersIntoForall takes it as an argument. Install it
in LLVMCPUTileAndFuseProducerConsumer with Equal alignment (the vector tile size
equals the scalable inner tile), so scalable linalg.pack/unpack tile and fuse at
the vector level without re-deriving the relationship from scalable IR.

getTiledImplementation, generateResultTileValue,
getTiledImplementationFromOperandTiles and getIterationDomainTileFromOperandTiles
(llvm/llvm-project#150185). IREE's in-tree TilingInterface implementers declare

it.

linalg.pack/unpack consult it) to the LinalgExt ops, the Codegen InnerTiledOp,

commit_message:
feat(tiling): forward InnerTileAlignment overloads on IREE TilingInterface ops

Upstream adds the optional InnerTileAlignment hint as same-name overloads of
getTiledImplementation, generateResultTileValue,
getTiledImplementationFromOperandTiles and getIterationDomainTileFromOperandTiles
(llvm/llvm-project#150185). IREE's in-tree TilingInterface implementers declare
only the hint-less methods, which hides the inherited defaulted hint-bearing
overload (C++ name hiding) and fails to compile once the interface forwards to
it.

Add trivial forwarding hint-bearing overloads (the ops ignore the hint; only
linalg.pack/unpack consult it) to the LinalgExt ops, the Codegen InnerTiledOp,
and the tensor.concat external model.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>

commit_message:
feat(tiling): add makeInnerTileAlignmentFn and thread it through tile-and-fuse

Add makeInnerTileAlignmentFn (TileAndFuseUtils), which builds an
InnerTileAlignment control function marking each scalable (dynamic) inner tile
of a tiled/fused linalg.pack/unpack with a given alignment. Thread the control
function through the tile+fuse helpers: fuseProducersOfSlices reads it from
SCFTilingOptions and fuseConsumersIntoForall takes it as an argument. Install it
in LLVMCPUTileAndFuseProducerConsumer with Equal alignment (the vector tile size
equals the scalable inner tile), so scalable linalg.pack/unpack tile and fuse at
the vector level without re-deriving the relationship from scalable IR.

Adds lit coverage in tile_and_fuse_producer_consumer_anchoring_root_op.mlir.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>
